run_make_ref_generate_reference: run the make_ref module to generate a reference file from stdin sentences with BPE restoration
run_make_ref_restore_segmentation: run the make_ref module to restore BPE segmentation on a reference file at a given output path
run_make_ref_replace_unk_tokens: run the make_ref module to replace <unk> tokens with <<unk>> markers in input sentences
run_make_ref_write_sentences_to_file: run the make_ref module to write stdin sentences to an output file with newline separation
run_make_ref_validate_output_path: run the make_ref module to assert output path is provided and does not already exist as a file
